Interface DbCollection

All Known Implementing Classes:
DbAbstractCollection, DbArray, DbStringCollection
public interface DbCollection
Read and write a collection of data items from/to database. All items are the same jdbctype. How the items are stored is independent of this interface. There is no presumption that input/output data is copied; it should not be modified.

Some static methods useful for working with collections.

Since:
4.0.0
